The Moving Averages technical indicator is a way of identifying a trend by using the average of previous closing prices. The RSI, sometimes referred to as the Relative Strength Index, is a momentum oscillator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversold conditions in an asset. The Fibonacci Retracement technique is a common way to identify potential areas of support and resistance. Bollinger Bands are an indicator that plots lines above and below a moving average to show how volatile a price has been. The MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) technical indicator is used to identify trend changes and potential trade opportunities.
